install.Windows x64: Download https://commandcode.ai/download/windows and run the setup file. The installer may be unsigned; only use this official link.
install.macOS Apple Silicon: Download https://commandcode.ai/download/mac?arch=arm64, open the DMG and move Command Code to Applications.
install.macOS Intel: Download https://commandcode.ai/download/mac?arch=x64, open the DMG and move Command Code to Applications.
install.Linux .deb: Download https://commandcode.ai/download/linux, then run sudo apt install ./CommandCode-*.deb.
install.note: Command Code is installed as the desktop app. The agent runtime ships inside it, so do not use npm and do not install any separate command-line package.

first_run.description: Open Command Code and sign in, or add an account in EchoBird.

identity_guard.description: The product is Command Code, the desktop app from commandcode.ai. Do not call it Command Code CLI or install it with npm. It is not Claude Code.
